newsitem.title: EGYPT: ARB ELC TELEMISR profits down in nine months of 95/96.
newsitem.headline: ARB ELC TELEMISR profits down in nine months of 95/96.

text.p: Telemisr/Arab Radio Transistor and Electronics Supplies made net after-tax profits of 10.340 million pounds in the first nine months of financial year 1995/6, against 10.588 million in full 1994/5, according to audited results made available on Monday.
Profits before tax, however, rose to 16.696 million from 13.541 million in the previous year.
Turnover in the first nine months was 180.880 million pounds, up from 170.037 million in the full previous year.
The state earlier this month sold the private sector 76 percent, or some 1.53 million shares, in the company at 30.00 pounds a share. The shares closed on Sunday at 33.00 pounds.
